name: Enterprise Invoice-Payment Allocation
constraints: Commercial-document and payment identifiers remain distinct.
Every allocation pins payment, document, sequence, signed amount, currency, party, instant and basis.
Payer-advised, payee-applied and accepted allocations remain distinct states.
Document residual derives from the complete allocation set and correction chain at an instant.
Cross-currency allocation preserves settlement amount, document amount, rate quote, basis, time, source, FX and rounding differences.
Allocations cannot exceed final settlement amount net of explicit deductions.
Document allocation cannot exceed admissible claim without an explicit overpayment or exception.
Post-finality recovery uses a new payment and counter-allocation.
Closure requires zero residual, final payment, no open dispute and no discharge exception.
Reconciliation never establishes delivery or fulfilment.
